description: This Java class 'VmTraces' is part of the 'com.android.bugreport.stacks' package. It contains lists of ProcessSnapshot objects representing various process states (all processes, interesting processes, deadlocked processes) and provides methods to retrieve a process or thread based on process ID and thread name, respectively. The class is used within the context of analyzing Android bug reports, specifically related to VM traces and process states during ANRs.

classes.name: VmTraces
classes.description: Holds information about processes involved in ANRs during a bug report, providing access methods for process and thread retrieval.

methods.name: getProcess
methods.description: Retrieves a ProcessSnapshot object matching the given process ID (pid). Returns null if no such process is found.

methods.name: getThread
methods.description: Retrieves a ThreadSnapshot from a process specified by pid and thread name. Returns null if the process doesn't exist or the thread isn't found.
